description: Phase 6 prototype - chemicals.json. What the chemical IS (no times, no dilutions - those moved to formulations.json). Derived from data/chemicals.json v5. manufacturer + physicalForm (Q7 resolved 2026-08-11 — replaces isLiquid).

chemicals.name: Rodinal
chemicals.notes: Classic stand developer, highly concentrated. One-shot: mix fresh per use, cannot be reused.

chemicals.name: DF96 Monobath
chemicals.notes: Single-step developer + fixer monobath. One solution, no stop or fix needed.

chemicals.name: Ilfostop
chemicals.notes: Acid stop bath with indicator dye. Reusable by capacity: ~15 rolls per liter working solution.

chemicals.name: Rapid Fixer
chemicals.notes: Fast-acting rapid fixer. Reusable by capacity: ~24 rolls per liter working solution (1+4). Use clearing-time test to check exhaustion.

chemicals.name: Photo-Flo
chemicals.notes: Liquid wetting agent for final rinse.
